summary: Mutation reconciliation and file cache freshness require explicit contracts before consumer implementation. No actual UI/runtime approval.

open_findings.title: Freeze mutation outcome reconciliation before Stage 3
open_findings.impact: Receipt/status lookup and per-operation identity are missing. Snapshot idle/existence must not clear unknown.
open_findings.correction: Specify operation identity, authoritative outcome evidence, lookup and unknown release conditions, or explicitly preserve runtime-lifetime unknown and defer receipt reconciliation.

open_findings.title: Tie file cache freshness to real file changes
open_findings.impact: Tool edits or external deletion/recreation can leave stale previews after reopening.
open_findings.correction: Specify cache keys, forced refresh, mutation invalidation, external-change revalidation, stale display and regression cases before Query migration.
